questions.title: Single Number II
questions.question: Every element appears three times except one, which appears once. Find it (go from brute force toward O(n) time, O(1) space).

questions.title: Minimum Suffix Flips to All Ones

questions.title: Contains Duplicate II

questions.title: Divide Array in Sets of K Consecutive Numbers

questions.title: Partition Equal Subset Sum

questions.title: Furthest Building You Can Reach

questions.title: Migrate Between SQL Vendors
questions.question: How would you migrate a live database from one SQL vendor to another? Is two-phase commit practical, and how do you handle coordinator failure?

questions.title: Prevent Double Seat Booking
questions.question: How does a BookMyShow-style system stop two users from booking the same seat, and hide a seat from others once someone selects it? Discuss isolation levels and locking at scale.

questions.title: Scale an Overloaded Kafka Queue
questions.question: How would you detect that a Kafka topic/consumer group is overloaded, and how would you reduce the load (partitions, rebalancing strategies)?

questions.title: Sharding and Replication Strategies
questions.question: Database sharding strategies and choosing shard count, increasing read throughput, single-leader replication, replication lag, handling leader failure, strong vs eventual consistency, and speeding up slow SQL queries with the right indexes.

questions.title: Design a Stock Broker like Zerodha
questions.question: Design a stock broking app (Zerodha/Groww): watchlists, stock search, placing market orders sent to the exchange, live prices; drive your own FRs/NFRs, load, concurrency and resiliency.
